correctness.rationale: Conditioning a specified vertex to have zero indegree forces every image to avoid it. The restriction to the remaining labels is therefore exactly a uniform random mapping of size n-1 and preserves all cyclic vertices. The exact cyclic-point tails are proved by rooted-forest enumeration and yield strict stochastic growth with n. The Palm identity and all covariance signs then follow directly.

value.rationale: Zero-indegree vertices and cyclic vertices are canonical fringe and core observables of a functional digraph. The theorem gives an exact finite local-global relation, not merely a marginal recomputation: size-biasing by the fringe count reduces the core law by one vertex. The resulting sign holds simultaneously for every increasing core functional and has exact threshold formulas.
